# jamfplatform_pro_set_wallpaper (Action)

Sets the wallpaper on one or more supervised iPhones and iPads. Choose the picture with `image` or `icon_id`, and where it appears with `location`.

If a device already has this command waiting, for example because it is offline, Jamf Pro keeps that command and queues no other, so a changed picture or location does not reach the device.

The action commands every targeted device in a single request. If Jamf Pro cannot match one device, the whole request fails, no device is commanded and the error does not say which device it was, so a large batch is harder to diagnose than several small ones. Jamf Pro documents no maximum batch size.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Jamf lists this under **Platform environment** scope. You choose an integration's scope when you create it in Jamf Account, and cannot change it afterwards. The provider names the scopes it accepts when you configure it, and for a few families that is wider than Jamf lists here. Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Device actions | Destructive device actions | Execute | `destructive-device-actions` |
| Inventory | Devices | Read | `devices` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_pro_set_wallpaper" "brand" {
  config {
    serial_numbers = ["F2LXXXXXXXXX"]
    location       = "lock_and_home_screens"

    # Use a picture from disk, or an icon already in Jamf Pro with icon_id.
    image = filebase64("${path.module}/wallpaper.png")
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Where the wallpaper appears: `home_screen`, `lock_and_home_screens`, `lock_screen`.

### Optional

- `icon_id` (String) ID of an icon already in Jamf Pro to use as the picture, such as the `id` of a `jamfplatform_pro_icon`. Set this or `image`.
- `image` (String) The picture to use, as a base64-encoded PNG or JPEG, for example `filebase64("wallpaper.png")`. Set this or `icon_id`.
- `management_ids` (List of String) Jamf Pro Management IDs of the mobile devices to target. These are the `id` values reported by the `jamfplatform_devices`/`jamfplatform_device` data sources. The action commands all listed mobile devices in a single request. Each is looked up to find its serial number before the command is sent, so `serial_numbers` avoids that lookup. Set this and/or `serial_numbers`.
- `serial_numbers` (List of String) Serial numbers of the mobile devices to target (case-sensitive). Set this and/or `management_ids`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) How long the action may run before it is cancelled, as a duration such as `30s` or `10m`. Defaults to 5 minutes.
